architecture.block: 1x1 pointwise expansion; parallel depthwise 3x3/5x5 sum; channel shuffle; 1x1 pointwise projection; residual projection; ReLU6
architecture.head: 1x1 Conv, 5 independent logits

input_contract.storage: q.npy native [Z,H,W]; lossless packed binary labels
input_contract.padding: center native plane to 512; q=-128, supervision valid=0 in padding
input_contract.orientation: preserve source array axes and affine; no resampling/reorientation

config.loss: masked 0.5 class-balanced BCE + 0.5 per-class soft Dice; overlap-invalid voxels ignored by verified cache valid mask
config.augmentation: native-axis flips disabled for TotalSegmentator lobes because left/right class swaps require affine-aware relabeling; enabled for single-class/axis-neutral tasks
config.quarantined_policy: HiPaS quarantined cases excluded; other tasks use their saved/official split
